title: Only shrink the file name when there is insufficient space
goal: uses flex-shrink to allocate negative space and min-width: 0 to allow content to shrink.
summary: file toolbar is only 260px. The download button on the right must be 120px long, and the file name on the left must be shortened to the remaining space.
tasks: Make .file-label shrinkable, retaining its ellipsis handling.

example.note: The default minimum size for long content may stretch flex items. min-width: 0 allows the layout to shrink to the allocated space.

hint: button's flex-shrink is set to 0. The filename's min-width can be smaller than the content itself.
